paired_effect.mechanism: The natural arm exhausted its queue after 52 turns with no repository change. Reopening the unresolved action state regenerated continuation activity to the 64-turn limit, again without repository consequence. The intervention therefore reactivated rather than extinguished the targeted unresolved process pattern.
